Chapter 6973: No Saviors

Chapter 6973: No Saviors

Li Qiye slowly descended from the sky while holding the immortal bone. Meanwhile, spectators remained shocked and speechless.

At first, the emperors viewed him as a mortal, unaware that he would turn out to be their savior. Only Su Lianxin knew more about Li Qiye due to Tribulation Daoist’s introduction. However, she wasn’t optimistic.

The most emotional was still Tribulation Daoist who knew Li Qiye was an immortal from the outside world. He gambled that this man could save them just like Mundane Immortal.

Of course, the guy could have been a threat just like Heavenly Fortress.

“Sir, you’ve saved everyone, you are Survivor Realm’s savior.” He prostrated and performed a full rite after being freed from his seal.

“You are our savior.” The emperors prostrated.

“I am no savior. There is no need for saviors without destroyers, and more often than not, they are one and the same.” Li Qiye said.

They didn’t expect his response and became dejected after a brief reflection. After all, Godfiend Monarch was a perfect example. He desired to protect and save his world; his rushed ascension nearly took down Survivor Realm.

Everyone thought he was the only possible native to become an immortal. His attempt to live up to their expectation and his own was his downfall.

Tribulation Daoist also thought about his progenitor - another user of the bone. He and the others exchanged glances and let out a sigh.

“Sir, how does one save then?” Tribulation Daoist hesitated for a bit before asking.

“Focus on the self and maintain the dao heart. If everyone can do that, the world does not need to be saved.” Li Qiye said: “It needs immortals who can stay firm, not immortals who wish to save.”

“The dao heart.” They have never received this guidance before.

Li Qiye came closer to Godfiend and took a look. His body was obliterated but he was still alive.

The emperors didn’t know what to say. The overlord was their ancestor and had taught them the dao. They had nothing but respect for him, the same for the inhabitants of Survivor Realm.

He had protected them all this time but one mistake nearly cost everything.

“I was wrong. I was wrong.” He remained clear-headed despite the extraordinary pain: “I nearly destroyed Survivor Realm with my own hands. Dying a hundred times can’t atone for this, kill me.”

From the depths of his soul, he truly sought to protect this world and was willing to give everything for it. He believed that an immortal was crucial for them to survive.

First, foreign immortals were always an existential threat. Second, foreign protectors couldn’t stay forever. Therefore, he wanted to be an immortal to protect this world until his last breath.

“Where does your mistake lie?” Li Qiye asked.

“I shouldn’t have forcibly ascended. I became mad and nearly ended everything.” He was in great anguish for nearly destroying the thing he loved the most.
